spec.description: Real-time Drift Monitor

spec.title: Analysis Context
spec.description: Technical context for the latest AV run: dataset sizes, sampling coverage, feature count, and active AV thresholds.
ROC AUC of the adversarial validation classifier. Higher values indicate stronger separation between reference and current data.

spec.expr:
max(
  (
    ((drift_av_roc_auc or on() vector(-1)) >= bool scalar(drift_av_threshold{level="warning"}))
    + on()
    ((drift_av_roc_auc or on() vector(-1)) >= bool scalar(drift_av_threshold{level="critical"}))
  )
  or on() vector(-1)
)

spec.description: Delay between the current UTC time and the event_time of the latest processed valid event.
Share of events in the current window whose event_time is missing, is not a valid ISO-8601 string, or has no timezone.

spec.title: Over Selected Period
spec.description: Total events processed across all restarts within the selected time range.
Prediction drift status based on the most severe configured metric in the latest analysis.

spec.title: Feature summary
spec.description: Evaluated features with warning and critical metric alerts highlighted. See the Detailed tab for complete metric results and the Thresholds tab for global threshold definitions.

filter.options: /^(?:joinByField-C - Metric status-B - Metric value|A - Feature status)$/
/^(?:joinByField-joinByField-C - Metric status-B - Metric value-A - Feature status|D - PSI)$/

spec.description: Number of input-feature metric checks with a warning status in the latest completed analysis.

spec.expr:
(
  sum(drift_status{feature!="prediction"} == bool 1)
  and on()
  (max(drift_status{feature!="prediction"}) >= 0)
)
or vector(-1)

spec.description: Status of the latest completed analysis. Critical if any monitored feature is critical; warning if no feature is critical and at least one is warning; otherwise OK.
Features with warning or critical status out of all evaluated features.
Number of input-feature metric checks with a critical status in the latest completed analysis.

spec.expr:
(
  sum(drift_status{feature!="prediction"} == bool 2)
  and on()
  (max(drift_status{feature!="prediction"}) >= 0)
)
or vector(-1)

spec.description: Number of input features with a critical status in the latest completed analysis.
Status of incoming data stream.

spec.expr:
(
  max(drift_window_size)
  -
  max(drift_current_window_events)
)
/
scalar(
  max(rate(drift_events_processed_total[5m])) > 0
  or
  max(rate(drift_events_processed_total[1h])) > 0
  or
  vector(0.0001)
)
or on() vector(-1)

spec.description: Time between the earliest and latest event_time in the current window.
Largest event-time gap between adjacent events in the current window. Events are ordered by event_time before the gaps are calculated.

spec.title: Since exporter start⠀·⠀${process_start_time_s:date:DD MMM YYYY HH:mm}
spec.description: Current instance counter. Resets to 0 upon application restart.

spec.expr:
max by (dataset_name) (
  drift_reference_profile_info
)
or on() vector(-999)

max by (profile_created_at) (
  drift_reference_profile_info
)
or on() vector(-999)

spec.title: Global metric thresholds
spec.description: Global metric thresholds. Feature-specific thresholds from the config take priority.

spec.title: Prediction⠀·⠀Metric Values
spec.description: Prediction metric values over the selected period.

spec.title: $type features
spec.description: The leading marker color represents the overall feature status, while the color bar beside each value represents the individual metric status. The displayed metric columns are determined by the configured checks for each feature type.

spec.title: Prediction⠀·⠀Metric Status History
spec.description: Prediction metric status history over the selected period.
Stream status for each observed Prometheus sample.

spec.expr:
max(
  up
  and on (job, instance)
  drift_stream_status
)
or vector(0)

spec.description: Latest adversarial-validation status. AV status is determined by the configured ROC AUC thresholds.

spec.title: Top Drift Drivers
spec.description: Top-10 features that help the adversarial classifier distinguish current data from reference.
Adversarial-validation status for each observed Prometheus sample.
Standard deviation of ROC-AUC across CV folds. Lower means the drift signal is more stable.
Similarity of the current AV feature-importance vector to the previous completed AV run. High values mean drift drivers are stable over time.
Lowest ROC-AUC across CV folds; a conservative view of dataset separability.
Average cosine similarity of feature-importance vectors across CV folds. Higher means the identified drift drivers are more reproducible.

spec.name: analysis_status_filter
spec.query: All features : >= -1, All alerted : > 0, Warning only : == 1, Critical only : == 2
spec.label: Status

spec.name: history_status_filter
spec.query: All features : >= 0, Alerted during period : >= 1, Warning only : == 1, Critical during period : == 2
spec.label: Status

spec.label: Prediction metrics
spec.description: A list of metrics available depending on the prediction type
